description: This file defines the FeatureDefinitionCreated event class used in a Java-based Eclipse Ditto project. It models an event emitted when a FeatureDefinition is created on a Thing, including methods for constructing instances, converting from JSON, and accessing event data.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreated
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a Feature's FeatureDefinition was created, including information about the Feature, revision, timestamp, and associated metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of FeatureDefinitionCreated with given parameters, optionally including metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event data.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature associated with this event.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the FeatureDefinition that was created.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a different revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON entity associated with this event, in the specified JSON schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this event.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for this event, including feature ID and definition.
